title: Excelente
body: Excelente app. Interface simples e direta, facilita muito o uso no dia a dia. Só falta uma tradução para português para ficar perfeito
author: Angelosds

title: Truly Awesome!
body:
This is the best habit tracking app I've ever used. 
Congratulations and thank you very much!
I'd like to suggest integrating it with iOS's Screen Time feature, allowing you to, for example, break a bad habit by automatically tracking your social media usage time.
author: richardjhd

title: Please add Export CSV in Shortcuts!!
body:
Hello! First of all, congratulations on developing the app!

I came desperately to ask you to add a simple feature: please allow us to export data as a CSV file through Apple Shortcuts!
Maybe this would be relatively simple to implement (since the function already exists inside the app), but it would open up endless automation possibilities.

Thank you so much!
author: pslls00

title: Ótimo app para ter uma visão clara e simples dos seus hábitos
body: Eu não sou de avaliar app mas esse merece. Gostei muito do visual minimalista do app. Tudo é muito organizado e da para ter uma visão clara das minhas tarefas. É uma pena que o limite seja de 3 hábitos no plano gratuito, mas o plano mensal até que não é caro (8 reais)
author: Gabriel_bs

title: News Widgets
body: New Widgets, Such as Habit Calendars, to improve user productivity .
author: yMaximo

title: Great app, there’s only one missing feature
body: It would be great if we could see how many days are left in the current week to acomplish a weekly habit.
author: NNDOTHRN

title: Exceptional
body: This habit app is a game-changer. Not only is it visually stunning, with a sleek and intuitive design, but it also offers every tool you need to add and manage them effortlessly. It strikes the perfect balance between functionality, simplicity  and aesthetics, making habit-building an enjoyable process! After trying several similar apps in the past I can confidently say my search is over! 🙏🏻
author: marceleza-bh

title: This app is really awesome 🤩
body:
This is without a doubt the best habit tracker available today.

In addition to having a clean and minimalist design, it has integration with Apple Health and allows you to export all your data in CSV format.
author: rechmatheus

title: Muito bom
body: Assino pelo SetApp, então vale super à pena o preço da mensalidade! Os widgets são lindos e facilitam registrar os hábitos sem nem ter que entrar nele! Além disso, ele integra com o Apple Health e sincroniza várias coisas automaticamente. Gosto do design simples e que para os hábitos de tempo ele tem uma opção de iniciar um timer dentro do próprio aplicativo, o que estimula a focar naquele hábito.
author: ElisaM_

title: Very good app
body: Very good app. I use it daily. One thing I miss is having dynamic widgets with the list I created; it would be nice if the widget only showed the items from the list that I marked within the app. Currently, regardless of what I filter in the widget, all items appear. But other than that, the app is very good.

title: Best habit tracker!!
body: The best that I have ever used!!

title: Love it
body: I’m a busy man, this saves me time, keeps me disciplined, help me get results. So good this is the first app review I written 😄
